taskSets.name: Week 1 - Getting to Know Each Other
tasks: Win a game of tic tac toe.
Plant a tree. Keep it alive for a week.
Write a poem about nature together. Let others vote on it!
How well do you know each other? Take a quiz about your partner.

taskSets.name: Week 2 - Adventures Together
tasks: Go on a virtual adventure together using the bot.
Create a shared playlist and listen to it together.
Write a short story together, taking turns with each sentence.
Plan a virtual date and execute it through the bot.

taskSets.name: Week 3 - Creative Challenges
tasks: Draw or describe your dream house together.
Create a memory book of your favorite moments.
Write and perform a mini play together.
Design a couple's coat of arms or logo.

taskSets.name: Week 4 - Building Deeper Bonds
tasks: Share your biggest dreams and support each other.
Plan a surprise virtual event for your partner.
Create a couple's mission statement or goals.
Write letters to your future selves to read next year.

taskSets.name: Week 5 - New Interactive Challenges
tasks: House Design & Furniture Quiz - Discover your dream home compatibility!
Connect 4 Challenge - Play until there's a winner!
Love Letter Exchange - Write heartfelt letters to each other.
Vacation Planning - Plan your dream vacation together.
Daily Check-In - Check in with each other for 4 days.
Virtual Pet Care - Raise a virtual pet together for 2 weeks!
